categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies the legacy-to-SQLite wallet migration logic in src/wallet.
categories.rationale: Prevents migration failures from leaving wallets in an inconsistent half-migrated state requiring manual backup restoration. According to the PR description and review discussion, it delays deleting the original BerkeleyDB database until SQLite creation succeeds and catches unhandled exceptions that previously caused abrupt GUI crashes.
